# Claim-to-section map

| Front-matter claim | Formal support |
|---|---|
| An admissible boundary realizes `m-1` trivial staples and one central staple. | Proposition 3.2 |
| The conditional density is `p_t(U)^(m-1) p_t(z^{-1}U)`. | Proposition 3.3 and Appendix A |
| Every minimizer lies one `m`th of the way from the identity to `z`. | Lemma 3.5 |
| The target-good probability has exact exponent `-m(b_*-rho)^2`. | Theorem 3.6 |
| Bad probability tends to one under the worst-boundary supremum. | Equation (3.23) |
| The conclusion persists on an open positive-measure boundary set. | Theorem 4.1 |
| The selected Dobrushin row sum exceeds one for small heat time. | Theorem 4.3 |
| The result does not imply nonuniqueness or a mass gap. | Sections 4.2 and 7.3 |
| Restricted conditioning, averaging, blocking, and charged contours remain viable. | Section 7.2 |
